tools.name: find_capabilities
tools.description: Search every available tool, skill, prompt and command by what you are trying to do, and get back only the ones that fit. Catalog: 0 providers · . Use this whenever a task might need a capability you cannot already see — searching is cheap and the catalog is much larger than your tool list.

query.description: What you are trying to accomplish, in plain language. Describe the goal, not a guessed tool name.

kind.description: Optional: restrict results to one kind of capability.

tools.name: describe_capability
tools.description: Get full detail for one capability id from find_capabilities: the complete input schema for a tool, or the full instruction text for a skill or command.

tools.name: call_capability
tools.description: Run a capability by id and return its result. Works for tools, prompts and resources; skills and commands are executed by following the text from describe_capability instead.

arguments.description: Arguments matching the capability's input schema.

confirm.description: Set true to proceed with a capability that requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: add_server
tools.description: Register a new MCP server behind the router, instead of running `claude mcp add`. Pass url or command+args, or json for a pasted {"mcpServers":{…}} snippet. Rejected without confirm: true.

instructions:
This server is a capability router. Instead of loading every
available tool into your context, it exposes a search interface over all of them.

1. find_capabilities({ query }) — say what you are trying to do, in plain
   language. Top tool hits come back with their input schema attached.
2. call_capability({ id, arguments }) — run any hit by its id. A tool you call
   more than once is promoted into your tool list automatically.
3. describe_capability({ id }) — the full schema for a hit whose schema was
   abbreviated, or a skill's instruction text. Reading those instructions is how
   a skill runs.

Search before concluding something is impossible: the catalog is much larger
than your tool list.
